PreToolUse.description: goalforge launch gate: refuses a NEW Agent/Workflow dispatch when the remaining 5h quota is below the configured threshold (default 10%, README §Install) — a dispatch launched below it dies on the rate limit and loses its work. Quota comes from hooks/goalforge-quota-read.sh, which is an adapter and is deliberately NOT registered here. Unknown quota, or the gate disabled via its README-documented switch, exits 0 silently; the explanatory WARN prints once per session.

goalforge single-writer: blocks tool-surface mutation of status:/goal_approved_version: on plan files under a resolved PLANS_ROOT. The BLANKET field guard — it simulates Edit, MultiEdit, Write and ctx_patch payloads alike (ctx_call unwrapped one level), which is why the two Edit-only guards below can stay narrow. Fast-paths to exit 0 unless the edited file is under a resolved PLANS_ROOT.

goalforge status-edge guards, matcher Edit ONLY because both read an Edit payload's old_string/new_string and can evaluate nothing else: transition-guard (blocks an illegal status edge), open-questions-gate (blocks '-> ready' while an open question is unresolved). A status change arriving via Write or MultiEdit is caught by the single-writer group above, which blocks the field outright. Each fast-paths to exit 0 unless the edited file is under a resolved PLANS_ROOT.

SessionStart.description: goalforge session orientation, owned by the plugin so installing or removing it takes the injection with it: context-fill prints ONE estimate of how full the window already is; session-start prints the <=15-line orientation block (active features + frontier WP, ready handoffs, wayfind open/frontier counts, one routing line), privacy-scrubbed. Both exit 0 always and print nothing when there is nothing to say; GOALFORGE_SESSION_START=0 disables the orientation block.

PostToolUse.description: goalforge frontmatter-touch: bumps stage_updated: to today on an edited plans/** .md. Reads only the payload's file_path, so all three tools are in scope. Fast-paths to exit 0 unless the edited file is under a resolved PLANS_ROOT.
